deviation.description: The OSS licence gate's automated verdict is still FAIL for this candidate, and by design: four LGPL cases (LGPL-SHARP-LIBVIPS, LGPL-PSYCOPG2, LGPL-PSYCOPG3, LGPL-MOOCORE) sit in review_required with an empty exemption register. They are adjudicated -- the named operator recorded 'allow with conditions' for all four, first on 2026-09-08 in docs/evidence/human-decisions/ODP-OSS-DECISION-PACK-001/case-matrix.json (D01-D04) and again on 2026-09-18 in docs/evidence/human-decisions/ODP-HUMAN-DECISION-RECORDS-001/2026-09-18-oss-license-four-lgpl-cases.md -- but not by the external authoritative receipt that H01 and the project's own D14 decision require. No such external identity or receipt system is wired to this repository, so the licence gate cannot go green and license_policy.json stays 'proposed'. The dev-tool vulnerability findings (1 high, 2 moderate, all dev-only) carry a scope-limited risk acceptance recorded in docs/evidence/human-decisions/ODP-HUMAN-DECISION-RECORDS-001/2026-09-18-dev-toolchain-vulnerability-risk-acceptance.md. Two further required checks are deployment-time readbacks that cannot exist before a first deployment: the live default-deny egress probe and the live IAM state readback. Both stay assigned to ODP-DEV-LIVE-ROLLOUT-REMEDIATION-001 and are conditions on this deviation, not evidence for it. This deviation admits the dev boundary only; it does not clear gate-4 for staging or production.
conditions: The exemption register stays empty and license_policy.json stays 'proposed' until an external authoritative approval receipt exists; no AI agent may edit either to close this deviation.
The live default-deny egress probe readback and the live IAM state readback must be captured by ODP-DEV-LIVE-ROLLOUT-REMEDIATION-001 immediately after the dev deployment.
This deviation does not extend to staging or production admission; gate-4 must be re-adjudicated for those boundaries.
The dev-tool risk acceptance is bound to advisories GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh and GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 only, and lapses if any of those packages appears on a production dependency path.
